name: conflict-resolution-engine
description: Deterministic, replayable, auditable conflict-resolution engine for multi-agent document interpretations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
